title: Stabilizer Statistical Mechanics: A Framework for Efficient Quantification and Classification of Magic States
summary: The partition function is statistical mechanics' answer to an exponentially large spectrum, distilling it into a single analytic object whose temperature dependence resolves the full structure of the underlying ensemble. We show that magic, the resource separating universal quantum computation from classically simulable stabilizer dynamics, admits precisely such a description.
